description: Soft-delete a site (confirm:true required). It stops serving at once and is purged after the plan's restore window (purgesAt in the result); until then the user can restore it in the VibeDeploy dashboard. Use delete_site to remove the whole site; use remove_app instead to stop only its container services.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true to actually delete the site.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: delete_site

purgesAt.description: ISO time the site is purged for good: the end of the plan's restore window. Until then it can be restored in the VibeDeploy dashboard.

title: Delete a site (restorable until purged)
